info.title: ERP Smart Assistant API
info.description: Public entry point for ERP Smart Assistant. Chat, streaming, conversations, and approvals are forwarded to the Coordinator. Document management is forwarded directly to the RAG service. Legacy endpoints (POST /conversations, POST /messages) are preserved for compatibility.

post.description: Legacy endpoint. In the new flow, conversations are created automatically on the first chat. Preserved for backward compatibility.

schema.title: Response List Conversations Api V1 Conversations Get
Response List Messages Api V1 Conversations  Conversation Id  Messages Get

post.description: Legacy endpoint. Preserved for backward compatibility. Internally forwarded to /api/v1/assistant/chat on the Coordinator. New clients should use POST /api/v1/assistant/chat directly.

schema.title: Response List Documents Api V1 Documents Get
Response List Document App Ids Api V1 Documents App Ids Get
Response List Document Versions Api V1 Documents By Logical  Logical Doc Id  Versions Get

post.summary: Upload a PDF or DOCX document
post.description: Uploads a file, extracts text, chunks it, and indexes it in Qdrant. Creates a new version if the doc already exists.

post.summary: Replace all text documents of an app (atomic)
post.description: Replaces all text documents of an app_id in a single batch. If any document fails, none are committed (all-or-nothing). For per-document upsert/versioning, use /create-text2.
Upserts text documents with per-document commit/rollback. A failure in one document does not block the others. Creates a new version if the doc already exists (based on content hash).

delete.summary: Delete versions of a logical document
delete.description: Deletes versions of a logical document. allVersions=False: only current, previous becomes current. allVersions=True: all versions from Postgres and Qdrant.

delete.summary: Delete all documents of an app

delete.description: If this was the current version, the previous version becomes current.
